faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NCDC Sahakar Taxi Cooperative Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form for the Regional Chief Operating Officer posts is 21 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Regional Chief Operating Officer post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Regional Chief Operating Officer position, candidates must possess a Graduate degree in Engineering (B.Tech/M.Tech) along with a full-time MBA/PGDM/Executive MBA. This combination of technical and management education is essential.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all applicants applying for the Regional Chief Operating Officer posts is 50 years. However, there might be provisions for age relaxation for exceptional candidates as per the organization's policy.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. NCDC Sahakar Taxi Cooperative has waived off the application fee for all applicants.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the NCDC Sahakar Taxi Cooperative Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out carefully, attach necessary documents, and send it via Speed Post or Registered Post to the address mentioned in the official notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Regional Chief Operating Officer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the post of Regional Chief Operating Officer. These vacancies are distributed across different regions, with one post each for East, West, and South.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment for the Regional Chief Operating Officer posts is on a contractual basis. This means the selected candidates will be appointed for a specific period as per the terms and conditions of the contract.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and the application form can be downloaded from the official website of NCDC Sahakar Taxi Cooperative, which is www.bharattaxiapp.com. Links are also provided in the "Important Links" section of this article.

faq.answer: The salary details for the Regional Chief Operating Officer position are not explicitly mentioned in the provided data. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for comprehensive information regarding the salary structure and benefits.
